title: Energy Extension
description: STAC Energy Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.
This is the schema for STAC Collections.

anyOf.$comment: This is the schema for top-level Collection fields. If given, requires at least one energy field.

allOf.$comment: Require fields here for Collections at top level.

anyOf.$comment: This is the schema for the fields in Collection Summaries. If given, requires at least one energy summary field.

allOf.$comment: Require fields here for Collection summaries.

require_any_top_level_field.$comment: Requires at least one meaningful field to be present in Collection top level.

top_level_fields.$comment: Defines the allowed top-level fields for Collections.

require_any_summary_field.$comment: Requires at least one meaningful summary field to be present in Collection summaries.

summary_fields.$comment: Defines the allowed summary fields for Collections. Categorical fields are arrays of strings; numerical fields are range objects.

energy:entity_type.title: Entity Type Summary
energy:entity_type.description: Set of entity type values present in the Collection.

energy:fuel_type.title: Fuel Type Summary
energy:fuel_type.description: Set of fuel type values present in the Collection.

energy:fuel_subtype.title: Fuel Subtype Summary
energy:fuel_subtype.description: Set of fuel subtype values present in the Collection.

energy:status.title: Status Summary
energy:status.description: Set of operational status values present in the Collection.

energy:measurement_type.title: Measurement Type Summary
energy:measurement_type.description: Set of measurement type values present in the Collection.

energy:generation_capacity.title: Generation Capacity Summary
energy:generation_capacity.description: Range of installed generation capacity values (MW) across the Collection.

energy:storage_power.title: Storage Power Summary
energy:storage_power.description: Range of maximum storage charge/discharge power values (MW) across the Collection.

energy:storage_capacity.title: Storage Capacity Summary
energy:storage_capacity.description: Range of total storage capacity values (MWh) across the Collection.

fields.$comment: All extension fields are listed here. They are not required (that is done above in the corresponding schema).

energy:entity_type.title: Entity Type
energy:entity_type.description: The structural level the item represents (e.g. unit, group, facility, portfolio, region, unknown).

energy:group_name.title: Group Name
energy:group_name.description: Name of the sub-facility group. Only permitted if entity_type is 'unit'.

energy:facility_name.title: Facility Name
energy:facility_name.description: Name of the overarching facility. Only permitted if entity_type is 'unit' or 'group'.

energy:operator.title: Operator
energy:operator.description: Name of the company that operates the entity.

energy:entity_osm_id.title: Entity OSM ID
energy:entity_osm_id.description: The OpenStreetMap (OSM) ID associated with the entity.

energy:group_osm_id.title: Group OSM ID
energy:group_osm_id.description: The OSM ID of the sub-facility group. Only permitted if entity_type is 'unit'.

energy:facility_osm_id.title: Facility OSM ID
energy:facility_osm_id.description: The OSM ID of the overarching facility. Only permitted if entity_type is 'unit' or 'group'.

energy:entity_ids.title: Entity IDs
energy:entity_ids.description: Dictionary of IDs mapping ID types to values.

energy:fuel_type.title: Fuel Type
energy:fuel_type.description: The primary fuel used to generate energy (e.g. gas, coal, oil, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, storage, hybrid).

energy:fuel_subtype.title: Fuel Subtype
energy:fuel_subtype.description: The subtype of fuel used (e.g. lng, offshore, pv).

energy:hybrid_fuel_types.title: Hybrid Fuel Types
energy:hybrid_fuel_types.description: The multiple fuel types used to generate energy. Required if fuel_type is 'hybrid'.

energy:hybrid_fuel_ratios.title: Hybrid Fuel Ratio
energy:hybrid_fuel_ratios.description: Fraction or percentage of each fuel used in a hybrid system.

energy:generation_capacity.title: Generation Capacity
energy:generation_capacity.description: Installed capacity of the purely generating assets. Unit: MW.

energy:storage_power.title: Storage Power
energy:storage_power.description: Maximum charge/discharge power of the storage system. Unit: MW.

energy:storage_capacity.title: Storage Capacity
energy:storage_capacity.description: Total volume of energy the storage system can hold. Unit: MWh.

energy:status.title: Status
energy:status.description: Operational status of the entity (e.g. active, inactive, under_construction, decommissioned).

energy:measurement_type.title: Measurement Type
energy:measurement_type.description: Describes the kind of data recorded (e.g. gross_generation, net_generation, simulated_generation).

allOf.$comment: energy:hybrid_fuel_types is required when energy:fuel_type is 'hybrid'.
energy:hybrid_fuel_types and energy:hybrid_fuel_ratios are only permitted when energy:fuel_type is 'hybrid'.
energy:group_name and energy:group_osm_id are only permitted when energy:entity_type is 'unit'.
energy:facility_name and energy:facility_osm_id are only permitted when energy:entity_type is 'unit' or 'group'.

^(?!energy:).$comment: Above, change `energy` to the prefix of this extension
